---
title: "Amion Cache Refresh"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: true
  warning: false
---

Pulls Amion schedule data + the RDM crosswalk, rebuilds amiontools'
aggregate rotation/team/time-allocation summaries, and writes them to the
`app_cache` REDCap record (separate fields from the milestone medians
cache) so ind.dash's Schedule tab can load in ~1 second instead of
re-fetching Amion + recomputing on every session.

Deliberately aggregate-only — full per-resident-day detail
(`build_daily_detail()`) is ~12 MB and far too large for a REDCap Notes
Box field; that stays a live fetch.

Schedule this content **weekly** on Posit Connect Cloud — separate
schedule from `refresh.qmd`'s 30-60 min cadence, since Amion's academic-year
schedule is pre-built in advance and doesn't change intraday the way
faculty-entered evaluations do.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(amiontools)
library(gmed)
library(dplyr)

# Required for institutional REDCap SSL certificate
httr::set_config(httr::config(ssl_verifypeer = FALSE, ssl_verifyhost = FALSE))

required_vars <- c("REDCAP_URL", "RDM_TOKEN", "CACHE_RECORD_ID")
missing_vars  <- required_vars[!nzchar(Sys.getenv(required_vars))]
if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required environment variables: ", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "))
}

REDCAP_URL      <- Sys.getenv("REDCAP_URL")
RDM_TOKEN       <- Sys.getenv("RDM_TOKEN")
CACHE_RECORD_ID <- Sys.getenv("CACHE_RECORD_ID")
```

```{r}
#| label: pull-amion
start_time <- Sys.time()
cat("Starting Amion + crosswalk pull at", format(start_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n")

crosswalk <- get_amion_crosswalk(RDM_TOKEN, REDCAP_URL, verified_only = TRUE)

# IMPORTANT: fetch_amion_data() called with no `urls=` defaults to pulling
# EVERY academic year since AMION_START_AY (2022) through the present --
# every other caller in amiontools (use_amion_data(), build_*_summary()'s
# own internal default, daily_detail.R) explicitly scopes to the current
# AY via build_amion_urls(..., start_ay=, end_ay=current_ay_start()).
# Match that here -- an earlier version of this script called
# fetch_amion_data() bare and silently pulled 5 academic years (368K rows
# instead of 66.5K), inflating every per-resident total ~2-5x depending on
# tenure. Caught live 2026-09-04 via a real resident's numbers looking
# wrong in ind.dash, not by inspection.
amion <- fetch_amion_data(
  urls = build_amion_urls(AMION_LO_DEFAULT, start_ay = current_ay_start(), end_ay = current_ay_start())
)

elapsed <- round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs")), 1)
cat("Pull complete in", elapsed, "seconds\n")
cat("Crosswalked residents:", nrow(crosswalk), "\n")
cat("Amion rows:           ", nrow(amion), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: build-summaries
rot    <- build_rotation_summary(crosswalk = crosswalk, amion = amion)
team   <- build_team_summary(crosswalk = crosswalk, amion = amion)
talloc <- build_time_allocation_summary(crosswalk = crosswalk, amion = amion)

# Aggregate/per-resident wide tables only -- the same shapes the ind.dash
# Schedule tab modules already consume. NEVER add build_daily_detail() here
# (see file header -- ~12 MB, blows past REDCap's field-size ceiling).
# Field set matches exactly what mod_rotation_summary/mod_team_summary/
# mod_time_allocation read off their respective build_*_summary() results
# (cross-checked against each module's source, not guessed) -- team_
# program_avg_wide is the one exception, not read by any current module,
# kept anyway as cheap forward-value for the future program-wide dashboard.
summaries <- list(
  rotation_summary_wide   = rot$summary_wide,
  rotation_class_avg_wide = rot$class_avg_wide,
  team_summary_wide       = team$team_summary_wide,
  team_class_avg_wide     = team$class_avg_wide,
  team_off_summary_wide   = team$off_summary_wide,
  team_off_class_avg_wide = team$off_class_avg_wide,
  team_program_avg_wide   = team$program_avg_wide,
  talloc_summary_wide     = talloc$summary_wide,
  talloc_class_avg_wide   = talloc$class_avg_wide
)

cat("Summary tables built:", paste(names(summaries), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: write-cache
ok <- gmed::write_amion_cache(
  summaries       = summaries,
  rdm_token       = RDM_TOKEN,
  redcap_url      = REDCAP_URL,
  cache_record_id = CACHE_RECORD_ID
)

if (isTRUE(ok)) {
  cat("Amion cache updated successfully\n")
} else {
  cat("WARNING: Amion cache write failed — check logs above\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: summary
cat("---\n")
cat("Completed at:", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n")
```
